OUTPUT: One portrait image, target 1080 × 1350. All essential faces and the defining mechanism remain inside the crop.

CONSTRAINTS: No copied branding, visible application UI, album art, readable text, watermark, malformed objects, extra fingers or merged anatomy. This is personal creative imagery, not a product-fidelity catalogue workflow. Identity preservation is requested, not guaranteed by PicMagic.
